email.subject1: a signal play for your partners
email.body1:
Samantha, saw Intelligems shipped its biggest quarter yet, including an MCP server and Slack bot across the Shopify ecosystem.

When the product expands that fast, partner-sourced pipeline usually cannot keep pace, because covering every agency and app partner at scale is more than a team can touch. Our AI SDR researches, writes, and follows up on its own, so co-sell coverage scales without new headcount: 3-5x more meetings per rep.

I built a signal play for the Intelligems partner ecosystem off hiring and tech-stack signals, and accounts showing them tend to progress about 4.4x faster. Worth 15 minutes for me to walk you through it?
email.subject2: drafts to your top partner targets
email.body2:
Samantha, quick follow-up for Intelligems.

Most partnerships teams know exactly which agency and platform partners to co-sell into but cannot work them all by hand, so the best targets go untouched and partner-sourced pipeline plateaus.

I had our AI SDR draft three personalized emails to three top partner targets for Intelligems. Want to hop on a quick call and I will walk you through them, then show how the same engine runs the whole partner ecosystem?
email.body3:
Samantha, last bit of proof for Intelligems.

Memgraph had more in-market accounts than the team could touch and could not hire SDRs fast enough. They ran our AI SDR to $2.7M in pipeline, 600 replies, and 60 BANT-qualified deals in 90 days, same team, live in four weeks, every email auto-logged to their CRM.

I pulled a benchmark of how Intelligems' partner reply rate likely compares to other ecosystem-led teams. Want to grab time so I can walk you through it?
email.body4:
Samantha, I will stop reaching out on this one, but did not want to leave you empty-handed.

If scaling partner-sourced pipeline without adding headcount is not a priority this quarter, no problem at all. Timing is everything, and I know a record product quarter keeps the team busy.

Before I close your file, worth 15 minutes to walk through a one-page co-sell pilot playbook scoped to your partner motion? I will tailor it to Intelligems either way.
